title: Updates on Tick Size for Multiple USDⓈ-M Perpetual Futures Contracts (2026-06-04 & 2026-06-08)
text: This is a general Binance Exchange Notice. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, In order to increase market liquidity and improve users’ trading experience, Binance will adjust the tick size (i.e., the minimum change in the unit price) of the below USDⓈ-M Perpetual Futures Contracts on the following dates as below: Adjustment Time Trading Pair Tick Size Before Adjustment Tick Size After Adjustment 2026-06-04 06:30 (UTC) ESPORTSUSDT 0.0001 0.00001 ARIAUSDT 0.0001 0.00001 WLFIUSDT 0.0001 0.00001 WLFIUSDC 0.0001 0.00001 KATUSDT 0.00001 0.000001 GUNUSDT 0.00001 0.000001 SANTOSUSDT 0.001 0.0001 MANTRAUSDT 0.00001 0.000001 MEUSDT 0.0001 0.00001 LABUSDT 0.0001 0.001 2026-06-08 06:30 (UTC) HOTUSDT 0.000001 0.0000001 2026-06-08 06:45 (UTC) ZILUSDT 0.00001 0.000001 2026-06-08 07:00 (UTC) IOTXUSDT 0.00001 0.000001 2026-06-08 07:15 (UTC) ONTUSDT 0.0001 0.00001 2026-06-08 07:30 (UTC) RVNUSDT 0.00001 0.000001 Notes:  The adjustment will  not  impact USDⓈ-M Futures trading operations  except USDⓈ-M HOTUSDT, ZILUSDT, IOTXUSDT, ONTUSDT  and  RVNUSDT Perpetual Futures Contracts .  The trading function of USDⓈ-M  HOTUSDT, ZILUSDT, IOTXUSDT, ONTUSDT  and  RVNUSDT  Perpetual Futures Contracts will be suspended as below: USDⓈ-M HOTUSDT Perpetual Futures Contract: from  2026-06-08 06:30 (UTC) to 2026-06-08 06:31 (UTC) USDⓈ-M ZILUSDT Perpetual Futures Contract: from  2026-06-08 06:45 (UTC) to 2026-06-08 06:46 (UTC) USDⓈ-M IOTXUSDT Perpetual Futures Contract: from  2026-06-08 07:00 (UTC) to 2026-06-08 07:01 (UTC) USDⓈ-M ONTUSDT Perpetual Futures Contract: from  2026-06-08 07:15 (UTC) to 2026-06-08 07:16 (UTC) USDⓈ-M RVNUSDT Perpetual Futures Contract: from  2026-06-08 07:30 (UTC) to 2026-06-08 07:31 (UTC) During this period, users will  not  be able to place new orders, cancel and modify existing orders on the aforementioned contracts. The status of the aforementioned contracts will be updated from “TRADING” to “PENDING_TRADING. API users may use G ET /fapi/v1/exchangeInfo  to query the latest status.  Tick size via API will also change. API users may use  GET /fapi/v1/exchangeInfo  to find the latest tick size. For further details and updates, please refer to our full  API Changelog . The tick size update will  not  affect existing orders. After the tick size has been updated, orders placed before the update will still be matched with the original tick size. This information is released as a Notice under Binance  Exchange Rule  17. Please refer to  Trading Parameters  for more details and adjust your trading strategy according to the aforementioned changes to avoid unnecessary impact on your trading. There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2026-06-03 Note:  This announcement was amended on 2026-06-08 to update the tick size for RVNUSDT.
